author: architecture-closer
role: The exact, independently verifiable evaluation-proof object graph that V10 item 1 requires. evidence.v1 named the obligations but its validator checked field presence, so relationship matches, verdict derivation and the retained no-match closure could all be satisfied by metadata (R3-PROBE-01..03). This contract makes the commitments RECOMPUTABLE: a second process re-derives every commitment from retained objects and trusts no producer boolean.

decisionDependencies.supplies: E1..E10 obligations this contract makes executable
predicate-relative sufficiency (C-1); no global fact tier
the retention units this graph's refs must close over

canonicalCommitmentGrammar.why: R3-RTV5-01: evidence.v1 declared unit-separator plus length-prefix framing while check-evidence.py used pipe/newline framing and a truncated digest. Two grammars means no grammar. This is the single normative one.
canonicalCommitmentGrammar.oddNode: promoted unchanged to the next level
canonicalCommitmentGrammar.commitment: sha256(namespace || '/' || domain || 0x1F || merkleRoot) rendered as 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex
canonicalCommitmentGrammar.ordering: members are deduplicated then sorted by raw byte value ascending
canonicalCommitmentGrammar.truncationNote: a commitment is always the full 64 hex digits

local-match.rejects: a span or subject identity with no retained fact reference — a span locates, it does not prove

requires: witnessEdges (>=1, each with endpoints, relationKind and a resolvable factRef)
relationship-match.rejects: subject/span metadata alone; the verifier must be able to re-trace the relation

aggregate-match.rejects: a sampled or truncated member set (E4/RA-4)

no-match.rejects: factPartitionPinned booleans and bare digests; the universal negative needs a recomputable universe

verdictProofObligation.rule: The verdict is itself an evaluation. outcomeSetCommitment must RECOMPUTE from the complete set of (evaluationId, predicateId, outcome) triples of every activated evaluation. Coverage, baseline, waiver set and policy are content-addressed inputs.
verdictProofObligation.baseline: either a resolvable baselineRef or an explicit baselineDeclaredNone:true
verdictProofObligation.rejects: an arbitrary but well-formed digest, and an outcome set that omits an activated evaluation

invariants.assert: Every retained proof reference is content-addressed. No boolean stands for retained material.
Relationship and aggregate matches require a witness that subject/span metadata alone cannot satisfy.
Historical predicate semantics identity is retained and content-addressed for every evaluation.
A committed subject or member set recomputes exactly; cardinality agreement is not set agreement.
Verdict derivation recomputes the complete outcome-set commitment over every activated evaluation.
Coverage, baseline, waivers and policy are content-addressed verdict inputs; absence must be explicit.
Indeterminate and error outcomes are represented and can never be absorbed into an authoritative pass.
One canonical commitment grammar; full-length digests; deduplicated, sorted, length-prefixed, domain-tagged.
Every reference resolves in the retained object store; a second process verifies without trusting the producer.
Exact activation recomputes the universe commitment from declared members; count equality is insufficient.

positiveVectors.why: relationship match carries an ordered edge witness plus relation semantics
local match retains resolvable fact references, not only a span
aggregate match commits to its exact member set and fold
no-match commits to the exact subject universe with a resolvable fact partition
indeterminate is represented honestly and yields a non-pass verdict
a clean verdict recomputes its complete outcome set, coverage, baseline, waivers and policy

adversarialNegatives.why: R3-PROBE-01: relationship match proved by subject/span metadata alone
R3-PROBE-03: boolean fact pin instead of a content-addressed reference
same-cardinality subject substitution keeps the count but changes the set
local match retains no fact reference at all
reference is well formed but unresolvable in the retained object store
outcome set omits an activated evaluation while the verdict stands
universe commitment does not recompute from the declared members
truncated digest violates the one canonical grammar
an indeterminate outcome absorbed into an authoritative pass
relationship witness without relation semantics identity
verdict derived with no policy identity
baseline neither referenced nor explicitly declared absent
aggregate member count disagrees with the committed member set

assurance.why: A contract plus a retained checker is design-integrity evidence only. AS-1 applies: implementable:true performs no assurance transition. Nothing here is QUALIFIED or DEMONSTRATED, and no product gate is unblocked by this artifact.

knownLimitations: Authored by the same agent who authored the rejected v5. The positive vectors and the checker share an author; R3-RTV5-01 explicitly requires independently authored goldens before this can be considered settled.
Resolvability is modelled as membership in a declared objectStore. It does not prove a real content-addressed store returns those bytes, which is storage-architecture work.
The commitment grammar is chosen, not benchmarked. A1-RTV4-02 measurement remains open and no cost claim is authorized.
Predicate semantics is modelled as a content-addressed reference. Whether the rule IR is stable enough to rehydrate historically is a VERSIONING question this contract depends on but does not answer.
sealRecommendation: DO NOT SEAL. This repairs the proof-shape hole R3-RTV5-01 identified and makes the obligations executable, but it requires independent re-review by an agent that authored neither the contract nor its checker.
